evidence.observation: Ramp reached 749.7 °C against 749.6 °C setpoint with 81.5% heater power.
Growth transition showed a transient overshoot to 760.3 °C as heater power fell to 38.9%.
Temperature settled to 749.6 °C against 750 °C setpoint, with 44.8% heater power; preceding growth readings also settled near setpoint.
Argon flow is 100.1 sccm against 100 sccm setpoint and controller reports running; flow has tracked commanded values throughout.
Pressure and exhaust oxygen sensors are not installed; their null readings are not evidence of a fault.

args.missing_evidence: Sample characterization is needed to assess target growth. Pressure and exhaust oxygen measurements are unavailable, so atmosphere integrity cannot be independently verified from this telemetry.
